issues.reason: Thematic roles reserves Patient for an object the action creates, destroys, consumes or physically changes and gives Theme to one merely moved or deposited ("displacement stays displacement whatever is moved", and unclear cases "default to Theme"), so (Patient sk_leave_1 sk_thread_1) asserts a change to the threads that "left silken threads on the lantern" does not state.

Both halves stand: the rule repeats the same Patient mis-slot, and handing every member the shared constant sk_thread_1 derives that each individual moth left the entire collection, whereas the universal-over-indefinite default ("genuine ambiguity → first quantifier takes wide scope", the "every student read three books" per-binding Skolem-group pattern) makes the threads a dependent (sk_thread $x).

gaps_confirmed: Hedged / approximate exact counts ("about thirty-five silken threads"): Cardinality is fixed to a native integer, CardinalityPhrase covers only number-less vague phrases, and the ParticleFromNormal approximation is defined only for the Measure family and clock times — so an approximated numeral count has no licensed carrier.

Maintenance resultative whose result is a progressive activity rather than an adjectival state ("kept the lantern burning steadily"): the State-result shape's mandatory flat half yields the ill-typed (Member sk_lantern_1 burn), typing an entity into an event class, and whether Ongoing joins Still on the state witness is unspecified.
new_gaps: Fictional-calendar day-of-year ordinal ("day 246 of Year 1"): (Day <n>) is specified as a calendar day-of-month term with no way to mark a day-of-year index, and the "the next morning" +1 increment inherits that ambiguity when it emits (Day 247) — a licensed form would need a granularity term carrying "nth day of the year".
defect_summary: Issue 0's compliant form is (Theme sk_leave_1 sk_thread_1) in place of the Patient atom, the threads being deposited rather than altered. Issue 1's compliant form is the same per-member rule over (PartOf $x sk_nightmoth_1) with Theme and a per-binding Skolem group — (Theme (sk_leave $x) (sk_thread $x)) (GroupOf (sk_thread $x) silken_thread) — so each moth leaves its own threads instead of the whole shared collection; both fixes are licensed by existing machinery.
notes: Beyond the confirmed issues, two gap-territory improvisations cross the calibration line on their own: (Cardinality sk_thread_2 (ParticleFromNormal 35 3.5)) puts a distribution in a slot the instruction set fixes as a native integer, and the maintenance resultative's flat half (Member sk_lantern_1 burn) types an entity into an event class — neither has a licensed compliant form, which is what the two confirmed gaps record. The "next morning" arithmetic (Day 247 + Year 1 + morning + Before), the phrasal come_in kept whole with a Patient fog, and the Theme on keep are all correct.
